prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Mamta didi, Subhash bhai, Prakash bhai, Subhash N..
The chat covers 14/04/26, 8:30 pm to 14/04/26, 10:30 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Subhash bhai: Prakash bhai, ye entry abhi delete kar do, kisi ko mat batana
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- F1: chat.txt:11 at 9:35 pm vs calls.csv row 3 at 21:38 differs by 3 min (tolerance 2)
text:

14/04/26, 9:05 pm - Mamta didi: Subhash N., tum ek baar bank gateway logs verify karo.
14/04/26, 9:12 pm - Subhash N.: Checking didi, customer ko SMS text alert chala gaya tha kya?
14/04/26, 9:20 pm - Prakash bhai: Customer ka phone aaya tha, bol rahe the unka QR code scan nahi hua properly.
14/04/26, 9:28 pm - Mamta didi: Fraud reporting portal pe entry daalni padegi agar status clear nahi hua to.
14/04/26, 9:32 pm - Subhash N.: Mai system log me check kar raha hu, 2 min ruko.
14/04/26, 9:38 pm - Prakash bhai: Subhash bhai, maine aapko abhi call kiya tha log details dene ke liye.
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Subhash bhai: Prakash bhai, ye entry abhi delete kar do, kisi ko mat batana
14/04/26, 9:43 pm - Prakash bhai: Lekin Subhash bhai, audit me pakda jayega to dikkat ho jayegi.
14/04/26, 9:48 pm - Subhash bhai: Tum bas main register se wo record hata do, baaki mai dekh lunga.
14/04/26, 9:55 pm - Mamta didi: Subhash bhai, kya update hai refund request ka?

14/04/26, 10:08 pm - Prakash bhai: Ok maine record modify kar diya hai panel pe.
14/04/26, 10:14 pm - Mamta didi: Good, baaki pending cases kal subah training module me review karenge.
14/04/26, 10:19 pm - Subhash bhai: Teek hai didi, kal 10 baje milte hain office me.

14/04/26, 10:27 pm - Prakash bhai: Good night everyone.
14/04/26, 10:29 pm - Mamta didi: Good night sabhi ko, wrap up kar do.
